chunks: Go ahead with the remembrance of Allāh for it is the best remembrance, and long for that which He has promised to the pious, for His promise is the most true promise. Tread the course of the Prophet for it is the most distinguished course. Follow the sunnah of the Prophet for it is the most right of all behaviours.

key_terms.أَهْدَى السُّنَنِ: The most right/guiding of the traditions

ai.seo_question: What are the four key spiritual practices recommended in Nahj al-Balagha for attaining piety and following the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this concise yet profound excerpt from the 'Pinnacles of Islam' chapter, Imam Ali (AS) synthesizes the core pillars of spiritual practice: abundant dhikr, hope in divine promise, and emulation of the Prophet’s sunnah. This triad reflects the Shia emphasis on balancing inner devotion with outward adherence to the Prophet’s exemplary conduct (sunnah) as the ultimate standard for guidance. The narration underscores that true piety is realized through active imitation of the Prophet’s lifestyle, which serves as the most direct path to divine proximity.
